name: The Kestadian Hope
source:
Living as a slave for her master Derkel, Axel's life is devoid of meaning. Bound by a strong tie, she long since forgot every hope of being free from him. When she goes on the Kestadian hope, a sand crawler made to help civilians traverse the massive desert of Arisa, she meets with sympathetic strangers that try to help her during a voyage that will be more chaotic than any passenger expected.

[From [url=https://lunrae.itch.io/the-kestadian-hope]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
作为主人德克尔的奴隶，阿克塞尔的生活毫无意义。被牢固的束缚束缚着，她早已忘记了摆脱他的一切希望。当她乘坐“凯斯塔迪安希望号”（一辆旨在帮助平民穿越阿里萨大沙漠的沙履带）时，她遇到了一些富有同情心的陌生人，他们试图在这次比任何乘客预想的更加混乱的航行中帮助她。

[来自[url=https://lunrae.itch.io/the-kestadian-hope]itch.io[/url]]
